title: Story premise ENT006: The Long Scarf Shortcut
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (physical comedy). Hook: My shortcut is getting longer. Takeaway/theme: Undoing the last step can be the quickest recovery.
description: A commuter wants to cross a tiny plaza, but a ridiculously long scarf keeps snagging harmless props and dragging a growing parade behind. Instead of tugging harder, the commuter walks the route backward to unwind every loop, then folds the scarf into a surprisingly small square.
